<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

Make decode context parallel compatible with hicache.  

## Modifications

Modify cache_controller to aware whether dcp enabled. When dcp enabled, as kv cache is stored among all dcp ranks in round-robin manner, each dcp rank only offloads kv cache in local rank. 

## Accuracy Tests

For deepseek v3.1, with command below to start sglang: 
```
/usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/sglang serve --model-path /home/local/workspace/models/DeepSeek-V3.1 --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30000 --mem-fraction-static 0.88 --tp-size 8 --log-level info --log-requests --log-requests-level 3 --trust-remote-code --enable-cache-report --enable-metrics --random-seed 0 --dcp-size 8 --chunked-prefill-size 16384 --max-running-requests 256 --cuda-graph-max-bs 256 --disable-piecewise-cuda-graph --disable-cuda-graph --enable-hierarchical-cache --max-total-tokens 4096 --hicache-size 20 --hicache-io-backend kernel --hicache-mem-layout page_first --hicache-storage-backend file --hicache-storage-prefetch-policy wait_complete --attention-backend flashinfer
```

Then, use `python benchmark/gsm8k/bench_sglang.py` to test for first round and stop sglang when test finished. 
Right after that, check `/tmp/hicache`, there're 32120 files which means kv cache is offloaded to local files. 

Then sglang is restarted with same command args, and test with `python benchmark/gsm8k/bench_sglang.py`. 

It shows there's no accuracy loss comparing with first round. 
```
# first round, dump kv cache to files
100%|██████████████████████████| 200/200 [02:15<00:00,  1.48it/s]
Accuracy: 0.980
Invalid: 0.000
Latency: 135.432 s
Output throughput: 140.653 token/s
# second round, load kv cache from files
100%|████████████████| 200/200 [01:31<00:00,  2.18it/s]
Accuracy: 0.980
Invalid: 0.000
Latency: 91.661 s
Output throughput: 201.830 token/s
```
Besides, we can observe that, some files in `/tmp/hicache` have different access and modify time, here's an example:
```
 # stat /tmp/hicache/8240038a32ac955be9e157a40aab2e8936dbd53d75c68e56ab9bd3d676a6ffb7_-home-local-workspace-models-DeepSeek-V3.1_dcp2_8.bin
  File: /tmp/hicache/8240038a32ac955be9e157a40aab2e8936dbd53d75c68e56ab9bd3d676a6ffb7_-home-local-workspace-models-DeepSeek-V3.1_dcp2_8.bin
  Size: 70272     	Blocks: 144        IO Block: 4096   regular file
Device: 0,52	Inode: 99126008    Links: 1
Access: (0644/-rw-r--r--)  Uid: (    0/    root)   Gid: (    0/    root)
Access: 2026-07-22 11:30:58.638018108 +0800
Modify: 2026-07-22 11:24:16.786911102 +0800
Change: 2026-07-22 11:24:16.786911102 +0800
 Birth: 2026-07-22 11:24:16.786911102 +0800
```


## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
